documents.instruction: The verifier reference must stay true to src/index.mjs: the receipt fields, the six verifyReceipt steps and their order, the verifyFirstReceipt claims, the onboarding bundle pinning, and every fail-closed gate must match the code exactly.
The error reference must list every WelesClientError code thrown in src/index.mjs with its exact message and trigger, and the bridge status vocabulary and thrown strings must match bin/ verbatim.
Every command in the quick start must run as written from a plain checkout, and every pasted output block must be reproducible by the named example scripts.
The examples index must describe only scripts that exist in docs/examples and run end-to-end with Node alone, offline except loopback.

The synthetic receipt this script writes must remain byte-for-byte the shape verifyReceipt accepts: schema weles.receipt.current, keyId/signature/signedPayload, and displayed copies of the six signed claims.
The script must verify through the exported verifyReceipt only, print frozen claims on success, and exit 1 with the WelesClientError code on refusal.
The demo must exercise the real WelesClient against loopback only, and the refusal codes it prints (origin-denied, action-denied, plaintext-secret-denied) must remain the codes submit throws.
